method: Re-solved each displayed sentence against all four choices and then checked stored proposed answer/explanation; uniqueness, naturalness, target-skill fit, distractor validity, and explanation consistency reviewed item by item. Note: source format co-locates proposed answers with stems, so strict answer-blinding was not technically enforceable in this connector-only run; no item was promoted without individual review.
notes: All 25 items uniquely require gerund complements among the displayed choices. deny/risk/delay/enjoy/discuss are valid with gerund complements in the displayed business contexts, no alternate choice is defensible, and the stored explanations match the keyed forms. Some actor-role choices are generic, but they do not create grammatical ambiguity. Full cross-bank semantic near-duplicate clearance remains outstanding.
